title: Qualification and release discipline
summary: The sealed v0.14 artifact passed 150/150 manifest entries, 24/24 source compilation, 81 deterministic tests, 0 failures and 4 explicitly skipped optional network probes. Qualification is against exact artifacts and does not treat a worktree as release evidence.
invariants: Fresh-extracted exact ZIP acceptance is the release evidence.
Optional live probes are never counted as deterministic acceptance.
Synthetic fixtures must be labelled synthetic and must not be represented as live captures.
A component package is delivered standalone unless the Architect explicitly requests a roll-up.
Do not claim Autobuild submission/acceptance while the project is in manual-packaging mode.
procedure: Regenerate MANIFEST.sha256 from a clean release tree.
Create the standalone ZIP with one top-level package directory.
Verify manifest, compile every source, run deterministic tests and boundary scans.
Record exact artifact SHA-256 and dependency baseline in VALIDATION.txt.

provenance.claim: Qualification scope and exact consolidated roll-up digest.
Focused assertions, complete deterministic results, compilation, scans and fixture honesty.
